text: The PropLine card (under the engine banner on the +EV tab) only shows while the engine has a PropLine list, and my engine restart threw the old list away; the new engine waits for its first scan (about 6 min) before its first sweep, so the card disappeared until then. It comes back by itself when that sweep lands (minutes). I've also made the engine keep the previous list across restarts so it can't vanish again; that goes live with the next engine restart (v0.114.22 release). You can also open it from the card or pull down on the screen once it's back.
